summary: Phase 2 CRM Tender Writer frontend E2E verified end-to-end against production preview URL: (1) Figures management (upload + caption edit + persistence + reorder+delete buttons + b64 stripped from GET), (2) Deep evidence traceability mapping (add/edit/delete manual sources with reference, 'Saved' indicator, persistence), (3) Template library polish in Submission Pack wizard (star -> is_default persisted + DEFAULT badge, rename dialog persists new label, delete button present, created_by shown), (4) Document preview renders (LibreOffice) for Templated + ITT + Traceability modes (980x1268 PNG in each). All required data-testids present and functional.

integration_issues.issue: After upload, server GET /crm/v2/tenders/{id} returns figures[].filename = null (data_b64 correctly stripped). UI shows filename locally from upload response, but on a fresh page load the file name subtitle will disappear (screenshot showed 'testfig.png · 0KB' from local state only). Not blocking user flow but slightly inconsistent — main agent may want to persist filename server-side.

Clicking figure-remove triggers a browser confirm() dialog; automated test dialog handler had timing issue and delete did not go through (server count remained at 2 after click). Manual click by user should work. Consider replacing native confirm() with an in-app modal for consistency and testability.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Persist figure filename in DB (currently null in GET responses).
OPTIONAL: Replace native window.confirm() on figure delete with in-app modal so state stays consistent and E2E automation can drive it deterministically.
critical_code_review_comments: CRMTenders.js is very large (>1800 lines) — Phase 2 added QuestionFigures + QuestionEvidence inline. Consider extracting them (and other question sub-components) to /pages/CRM/tenders/*.js to keep the file <700 LOC per system guidelines.
GET /crm/v2/tender-docx-templates returns {templates: [...]} (dict envelope) while the frontend expects an array in some places — confirm all callers unwrap the .templates key uniformly.

kbItems is loaded from /crm/v2/knowledge-base; evidence-kb-picker only renders when kbItems.length > 0. On the demo org KB was empty during this test so the picker was correctly hidden — not a bug, just noting that KB-backed evidence source path was not exercised in this run (E2E fell back to the manual + Source path).
